analysis_result.analysis: The model fundamentally misunderstood the temporal structure of the video. This reflects a failure in sequential reasoning and temporal anchoring. Additionally, minor perceptual misreadings of the shuffled words compounded the confusion, causing the model to construct an inaccurate sequence of events. The core failure is not mathematical or semantic, but procedural — the model did not recognize that shuffles are discrete, timestamped events, not frame-based visual changes.
